text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: High error rate detected on Dedicated-EU inference pool (dedicated-eu-01). Error spike started 2027-04-12T10:02:00Z — routing 5xxs and timeouts.
Kelsey: paging on-call now. I’m taking initial triage.
Raj: on-call — ack. digging into logs.
Sam-ops: seeing OOMs on nvidia-rtx nodes 3/4; kernel OOM killer logs attached.
Kelsey: good catch. Can you put the node list into cordon and drain? link: https://playbooks/redwood/dedicated-eu
Sam-ops: running: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-03 && kubectl drain gpu-node-03 --ignore-daemonsets` — doing now.
Raj: redirecting traffic to fallback pool, will update routing. `/routing switch --pool dedicated-eu-02` (ETA 3m)
Kelsey: I’ll draft status page + enterprise notifications. Who can pull account impact list?
Lina-cs: I have the enterprise roster. pulling customers with dedicated-eu tenancy.
Jordan-se: stacktrace shows this started after a model rollout (v2.3.7) to dedicated-eu-01. Reverting might help.
Kelsey: hold on rollback until we confirm capacity shift. Want to avoid flapping.
Sam-ops: node cordoned and drained; pods rescheduled. observed 40% reduction in 5xxs so far.
Raj: routing switch complete. error-rate trending down but latency elevated. `/metrics query error_rate{pool=\"dedicated-eu-01\"}`
Kelsey: good. Lina — can you paste the customer list and contacts? Need to send targeted notices to affected Enterprise accounts.
Lina-cs: copying below. Accounts on dedicated-eu-01 (primary):
- NorthStar Health — acct-ns-001 — primary: maria@northstar.health, sec: secops@northstar.health
- BlueWave Finance — acct-bw-443 — primary: amir@bluewave.com, sec: infosec@bluewave.com
- OrionMedia — acct-om-220 — primary: claire@orionmedia.tv, sec: ops@orionmedia.tv
- CedarBank Corp — acct-cb-88 — primary: legal@cedarbank.com, sec: itops@cedarbank.com
Kelsey: thanks. Drafting tailored impact statements. Please review and approve.
Kelsey: STATUS PAGE DRAFT (copy):
```
We are experiencing increased error rates and request timeouts for customers served from the Dedicated-EU inference pool (dedicated-eu-01). Mitigation is in progress: traffic has been routed to a fallback pool and we are draining affected nodes. Some requests may have failed or experienced higher latency between 10:02–10:25 UTC. Updates to follow.
```
Kelsey: ENTERPRISE NOTICE (common template):
```
Subject: Service disruption affecting Dedicated-EU inference pool
Hi {CustomerName},
We detected elevated error rates and timeouts affecting inference requests routed to our Dedicated-EU pool. Mitigation steps include redirecting traffic to an alternate pool and draining affected nodes. You may have observed request failures or higher latency between 10:02–10:25 UTC. We will follow up with a detailed incident report and any recommended actions. If you need immediate assistance, contact your account manager.
— Redwood Inference Incident Response
```
Lina-cs: tailored blurb suggestions:
- NorthStar Health: "This may have impacted inference for clinical decision support workflows; retries could have resulted in delayed patient chart enrichments. No data exfiltration detected."
- BlueWave Finance: "Batch embedding jobs may have seen partial failures; real-time inference for trading signals could have experienced higher latency."
- OrionMedia: "Live captioning and transcript generation may have delayed lines; video ingest pipelines should be reprocessing queued items."
- CedarBank: "Some internal batch scoring jobs may have failed and retried; we recommend checking job queues for duplicates."
Jordan-se: runbook note: if rollback is needed: `modelctl rollback --model redwood/v2.3.6 --pool dedicated-eu-01` (requires SE + SRE approval).
Kelsey: maria (AM) — can you own customer comms for NorthStar? @maria-am
Maria-AM: on it. I’ll send the tailored notice and follow up via phone. phone: +1-555-0102
Kelsey: Amir — can you ping BlueWave finance contacts and log the incident? @amir-bw
Amir-bw: will do. opening ticket INF-2027-042. calling secops contact shortly.
Sam-ops: mitigation looks stable. error rate back to baseline ~10:28 UTC. keeping monitoring for 30m.
Incident-bot: Incident INF-2027-042 created. Severity: P2. PagerDuty escalation: pages sent to on-call.
Kelsey: thanks team. Action items:
- Maria: send NorthStar tailored notice + phone call (ASAP)
- Amir: notify BlueWave, open ticket (ASAP)
- Lina: post updated status-page message when we verify stability at 10:35 UTC
- Jordan/Sam: continue to monitor, consider rollback if errors reappear
Kelsey: final approval on status copy? If no objections by :thumbsup: I'll post.
Raj: :thumbsup:
Lina-cs: :thumbsup:
Maria-AM: :thumbsup:
Kelsey: posting status now.
Incident-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INF-2027-042
Kelsey: closing thread for now; monitoring channel remains open. Will file postmortem and share customer-specific RCA and mitigation steps.
Lina-cs: filing tenant impact log and routing customer confirmations to CS tracker.
Sam-ops: :white_check_mark: all nodes healthy; will follow up with kernel OOM patch notes.
Kelsey: great work everyone.
